description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the MyLeaveRequestAPI, part of the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It tests various API endpoints like create, update, getAll, getOne, and delete, using mocks and data providers.

classes.name: MyLeaveRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the MyLeaveRequestAPI endpoints, validating CRUD operations and edge cases.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a leave request using data-driven test cases.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing leave request with different inputs.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all leave requests.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Validates that delete operation is not implemented and throws appropriate exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks validation rules for delete operation, which is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests fetching a single leave request.
